name: West Electric & Machine
old_description: West Electric & Machine Co. specializes in fast, reliable electric motor repair for all types of industries. We've been providing superior service since 1970. Call us today to let us know how we can serve you.
about:
West Electric & Machine Co., Inc. has operated from Morgantown, West Virginia since its founding in 1970. The company began as a specialist in electric motor repair, serving industrial customers across the region. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The shop provides electric motor repair services with an emphasis on quick turnaround. Its technicians handle repairs for a range of motor types and offer 24/7 emergency response for critical breakdowns. No facility size, employee count, or annual volume figures are publicly disclosed.

The company serves a broad industrial base, describing its customer base as "all types of industries." Specific sectors or named clients are not listed in available materials, though the service is aimed at any operation that relies on electric motors.

West Electric & Machine positions its speed and reliability as key differentiators, highlighting decades of continuous service since 1970 and round-the-clock availability for emergency repairs. The firm also notes a commitment to "superior service" as a founding principle.
